name: coordination-protocol-contract-package
description: The CPCP contract home: envelopes, refusal taxonomy, idempotency, method conventions, layer authority, operation identity and scopes, plus the base OWL ontology.
note: The contract home carries spec/ and ontology/ instead of a demo of its own. It declares no seam and serves no route: nothing here is reachable at any scope. The layout every CPCP package repo follows, including the per-scope manifests, is specified in spec/repo-format.md; this repo serves no seam and therefore carries the index alone.

standing_on.note: Base owns the shapes; CPCP is the transport of the grant and the packaging of it. Do not restate the base here.

scopes.rule: A scope answers which way the call runs, and how far. Outbound: this repo calls a CID somebody else serves (dependency). Inbound: this repo serves it, reachable beyond its pod (services) or only beside it (pod_internal). The method contract is identical at every scope; reach is not. A seam served both inside the pod and beyond appears in two manifests -- one seam under two rules, never two seams.
scopes.change_rule: Adding a scope to a seam is a contract change: update spec/scopes.md, the seam gate, and the demo matrix runner -- never just the compose file.

dependency.summary: A CID this repo calls, served elsewhere.
dependency.direction: outbound: entries are not seams of this repo
constraints: names the producer, its CID, and the operations actually called
declared whether or not the operation is built yet; status records which
a non-published status carries a because saying how that was determined
no exposure block: exposure is the producer's to measure, not this repo's to assert
dependency.invariant: Adding a dependency obliges the producer to nothing it has not already published.

pod_internal.summary: Served to containers beside this one.
pod_internal.auth: per-seam allowlist (*_CALLERS) plus Bearer; fail-closed boot on empty allowlists
constraints: a container without its caller token does not start
a caller without the operation does not pass
pod_internal.refusal: 401/403 plus envelope to an unauthenticated or unallowlisted caller is designed behaviour, not an error path.

services.summary: Served to callers beyond this pod.
services.auth: operator surfaces keep read-back asymmetry where it matters
constraints: host-published loopback for operators, editors and browsers, and anything served to the open internet
how far a surface actually reaches is measured in its exposure block, not asserted by the scope name
no direct domain writes except through CPCP admission
where a surface is internet-reachable: no credentials, no real data, replay-safe to observe
services.invariant: Publishing a port never widens what the seam admits.
services.defect: A public endpoint that admits a real write is a defect, not a demo.

unmapped.because: Live in magentic-stack (switchyard.route, cpcp.ready, cid) but absent from the map above. Browser-local credential routing, not pod-network traffic, so none of the three scopes is obviously correct. Needs a contract decision.
